Markets.title: Muthoot Finance Q2 cons profit jumps 36% YoY to Rs 3,278 crore
Markets.summary: Muthoot Finance reported a 36% year-on-year rise in consolidated net profit to Rs 3,278 crore for the second quarter, alongside a 42% growth in assets under management to Rs 2.09 lakh crore. However, its standalone gross NPA ratio deteriorated to 3.87% from 2.28% in the previous quarter.

Markets.title: Sebi to release FII compliance consultation paper within weeks, says chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey
Markets.summary: Sebi Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey stated that the regulator will release a consultation paper within weeks to align foreign investor compliance norms with global standards. The proposed changes come amid heavy foreign institutional investor outflows and include plans to strengthen independent directors through a capacity-building network.

Markets.title: US bonds rally, sending yields to biggest monthly decline since 2023
Markets.summary: US Treasury bonds rallied and yields saw their biggest monthly decline since 2023 as a tech stock selloff driven by Amazon and Intel earnings shifted investors toward safer assets. Despite this market shift, expectations for a December interest rate hike remained high following a recent Federal Reserve meeting.

Markets.title: NTPC Q2 Results: Standalone profit rises 14% YoY to Rs 5,320 crore; revenue up 17%
Markets.summary: NTPC reported a 14% year-on-year increase in standalone net profit to Rs 5,320 crore for the second quarter of FY27, alongside a 16.8% rise in operational revenue. The company also announced an interim dividend of Rs 3 per share and plans to increase its capital expenditure to support growth.

Markets.title: Dalal Street Weak Ahead: Nifty stands on firmer footing, but can it break past 23,450?
Markets.summary: The Nifty gained 2% last week to recover above its crucial 200-week moving average of 22,700, though bearish momentum indicators suggest caution. Analysts have identified immediate resistance between 23,300 and 23,450, with key support expected in the 22,525 to 22,750 range.

Markets.title: CDSL Q2 results: Net profit jumps 24% YoY to Rs 173 crore, revenue up 24%
Markets.summary: Central Depository Services Ltd (CDSL) reported a 24% year-on-year increase in Q2 net profit to Rs 173 crore alongside a 23.7% rise in revenue to Rs 395 crore. During the quarter, the depository added 75 lakh new demat accounts, pushing its assets under custody past Rs 89 lakh crore.

Geo-Political.title: 'We came back from hell', say Ukrainians after years in Russia-occupied front-line city
Geo-Political.summary: An evacuated Ukrainian couple described their experience surviving years in the Russia-occupied front-line city of Oleshky as "hell." The pair stated they had to cross minefields in search of food before finally escaping.

Geo-Political.title: Ukrainian evacuees reunite with family after years trapped in Russia-occupied city
Geo-Political.summary: Ukrainian evacuees from the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky have reunited with their families after enduring years without food, water, or electricity. Residents had been forced to survive by cooking garden weeds due to the extreme deprivation.

Geo-Political.title: Thousands demonstrate in Paris as protests spread across Europe
Geo-Political.summary: Over 320,000 people protested across France against the rising cost of living and poor public services. Clashes occurred between some demonstrators and the police as similar protests spread across Europe.

Geo-Political.title: Crypto firm Binance covers 90% of losses after $6.3bn hack
Geo-Political.summary: Binance has covered 90% of the losses resulting from a $6.3 billion hack. The FBI attributed this cyberattack to North Korea.

Geo-Political.title: India's opposition set to hold mega rally seeking election chief's resignation
Geo-Political.summary: India's opposition parties are planning a major rally to demand the resignation of the chief election commissioner. The protest is driven by concerns that a voter roll revision could exclude 130 million voters.

Geo-Political.title: More than 5,000 die from Ebola in DR Congo's deadliest outbreak
Geo-Political.summary: Government data shows that more than 10,000 people in the Democratic Republic of Congo have contracted the rare Ebola virus. Over 5,000 of those infected have died in the country's deadliest outbreak on record.

AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator recently discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result without any paid advertising. This experiment highlights the growing shift from traditional SEO to AI-driven visibility.

Data & Insights.title: Govt scraps export duty on petrol; hikes levies on diesel, ATF — check details here
Data & Insights.summary: India has removed the export duty on petrol for a fortnight starting October 31. Simultaneously, the government has increased the levies on diesel and aviation turbine fuel (ATF).

Data & Insights.title: India lifted 49.6 crore people out of poverty between 2011 and 2023, says World Bank report - Here is how it was done
Data & Insights.summary: Between 2011 and 2023, the World Bank reported that India lifted 496 million people out of poverty. This reduction dropped extreme poverty from 27.1% to 2.6% through consumption growth, increased employment, and expanded social transfers.

Data & Insights.title: Govt sets up high-level banking panel under Suresh N. Patel
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government has formed a high-level banking panel led by Suresh N. Patel. The committee will recommend structural and regulatory reforms to make the nation's banking sector globally competitive and financially resilient by 2047.

Data & Insights.title: Extreme poverty in India falls to 2.6% from 27.1%: World Bank
Data & Insights.summary: According to a World Bank report, extreme poverty in India fell from 27.1% in 2011 to 2.6% in 2023. During this same period, 496 million people rose above the lower-middle-income poverty line of $4.20 a day.

Data & Insights.title: ‘2026 resembles 1991’: Why CEA V Anantha Nageswaran wants India to rethink its growth strategy — what he said
Data & Insights.summary: Chief Economic Adviser V Anantha Nageswaran warned that global tensions and supply-chain shocks threaten India's access to critical resources. He urged the country to rethink its growth strategy by building stronger domestic capabilities, diversifying imports, and creating strategic buffers.

Data & Insights.title: West Asia conflict drives 15-20% surge in working capital demand at Indian banks, lifts corporate credit growth: Report
Data & Insights.summary: The West Asian conflict has increased working-capital demand at Indian banks by 15 to 20 percent due to higher raw-material costs and shipping delays. This surge, along with refinancing and acquisition-related borrowing, has helped drive corporate credit growth in the September quarter.

India.title: Quad Foreign Ministers Reaffirm Committment To Free Indo-Pacific: Statement
India.summary: Indian External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar met with counterparts from the US, Japan, and Australia at a Quad meeting in Atlanta. The foreign ministers reaffirmed their commitment to a free Indo-Pacific region.

India.title: 'Protest, Then Do Some Shopping': Rahul Gandhi After Traders Object To November 1 Rally
India.summary: Rahul Gandhi urged the Ramlila Maidan rally crowd to shop at Delhi markets following traders' objections to the November 1 rally. Local traders had requested that the INDIA bloc defer the event to avoid disrupting business.

India.title: At Quad Meet, S Jaishankar Highlights Importance Of "Maintaining Stability"
India.summary: Indian Foreign Minister S Jaishankar emphasized the importance of maintaining stability during the Quad Foreign Ministers' Meeting in Atlanta. Following the summit, he shared on X that he discussed these key regional priorities with his counterparts from the United States, Japan, and Australia.

India.title: Action On Ground Must Match Targets: Pollution Body On Punjab Stubble Burning
India.summary: The Commission for Air Quality Management inspected Punjab villages to address stubble burning. Farmers reported facing difficulties in using crop residue management machinery.

India.title: Noodles 'Too Spicy', 3 Men Thrash Fast-Food Shop Staff In Bengaluru
India.summary: Three intoxicated men in Bengaluru attacked fast-food shop staff because their noodles were too spicy. The accused picked a fight over the food's spice level before thrashing the employees.

India.title: Case Against School After Boy, 8, Assaults 6-Year-Old Girl In Haryana
India.summary: Police filed a case against a Haryana school after an eight-year-old boy assaulted a six-year-old girl on the premises. Preliminary investigations indicate that the school management was negligent regarding student security and supervision.

General.title: Laura Kuenssberg: Healey risks breaking minimum wage promise for younger workers
General.summary: Chancellor John Healey has suggested that younger workers might not receive the same minimum wage as older workers before the next election. Journalist Laura Kuenssberg reports that this move risks breaking the government's promise on equal minimum wages.

General.title: King to address slavery during Commonwealth speech in Antigua on final leg of Caribbean tour
General.summary: King Charles III will deliver a speech about slavery at the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting on Tuesday. This address marks the conclusion of his nine-day Caribbean tour in Antigua.
